headline.en: Give binary inspection a structured working state.
headline.zh: 为二进制检查建立结构化工作状态。

sub.en: binrev holds disassembly, functions, cross-references, strings and notes in a BinState that can be inspected directly or explored through a configured model loop.
sub.zh: binrev 将反汇编、函数、交叉引用、字符串与笔记保存在 BinState 中，可直接检查，也可通过配置的模型循环探索。

body.en: Lookup and cross-reference queries share a BinState.
body.zh: 函数查询与交叉引用共用 BinState。

body.en: Capstone analysis needs no model API.
body.zh: Capstone 分析无需模型 API。
笔记可以关联函数地址。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Decode a complete six-instruction ARM fixture embedded in the example, then print its functions and a callee’s disassembly.
note.zh: 解码示例内嵌的完整六指令 ARM fixture，打印函数及被调用函数的反汇编。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Disassemble 24 explicit A32 bytes with Capstone, carve functions and inspect a call reference. No model, Ghidra or real firmware.

body.en: Decode a complete six-instruction ARM fixture embedded in the example, then print its functions and a callee’s disassembly.
body.zh: 解码示例内嵌的完整六指令 ARM fixture，打印函数及被调用函数的反汇编。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/binrev.git
cd binrev
uv venv .venv
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .
source .venv/bin/activate

limitations.en: Capstone output is disassembly, not high-level decompiled source. Function carving and references are heuristic.
limitations.zh: Capstone 输出是反汇编，不是高级语言反编译源码；函数划分与引用识别属于启发式。

limitations.en: The demo uses six synthetic A32 instructions. No real firmware, Ghidra backend or live model is exercised.
limitations.zh: 示例使用六条合成 A32 指令，不验证真实固件、Ghidra 后端或在线模型。

limitations.en: Online exploration sends the selected analysis context to the configured model endpoint.
limitations.zh: 在线探索会把选定分析上下文发送给配置的模型端点。

body.en: Text logs lose the relationship between an address, its callers and your notes. A shared binary state keeps those objects addressable as an investigation moves between functions.
body.zh: 文本日志难以保持地址、调用者和笔记之间的关系。共享二进制状态让调查在函数之间移动时仍能按地址访问这些对象。

body.en: The Capstone path decodes supported instruction bytes and identifies candidate function boundaries and call targets. BinState stores the resulting functions and references. ToolRegistry exposes lookup and annotation actions; the optional OpenAI-compatible client drives those tools.
body.zh: Capstone 路径解码支持的指令字节并识别候选函数边界和调用目标；BinState 保存函数与引用。ToolRegistry 暴露查询和标注操作，可选 OpenAI 兼容客户端驱动这些工具。

body.en: The Capstone path decodes supported instruction bytes and identifies candidate function boundaries and call targets. BinState stores the resulting functions and references. ToolRegistry exposes lookup and annotation actions; the optional OpenAI-compatible client drives those tools.
body.zh: Capstone 路径解码支持的指令字节并识别候选函数边界和调用目标；BinState 保存函数与引用。ToolRegistry 暴露查询和标注操作，可选 OpenAI 兼容客户端驱动这些工具。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: Set the ISA and addresses to match the binary. ~/.binrev/config.json stores optional Ghidra and llm settings, including base_url, model and api_key. Offline inspect needs Capstone but no model credential.
body.zh: ISA 和地址应与二进制一致。~/.binrev/config.json 保存可选 Ghidra 与 llm 设置，包括 base_url、model 和 api_key。离线 inspect 需要 Capstone，无需模型凭据。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
binrev inspect firmware.bin --isa arm
binrev inspect firmware.bin --isa arm --func 0x100c
# Start model exploration only after configuring its endpoint:
binrev firmware.bin --isa arm -q "List the entry function calls"
